title: Pukka Juice Blackberry Lime Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: This mouth-watering blend of flavours pairs sweet, jammy blackberries with the zesty, uplifting edge of tangy lime, and finishes all to perfection with a cooling layer of smooth, minty menthol for the ultimate in fruity-flavoured refreshment. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
